$description: Halal Goes design tokens. W3C DTCG draft format. Single source of truth for the customer app (Expo/RN), rider app (Expo/RN), restaurant web and admin web. Consumed by Style Dictionary -> NativeWind preset + CSS custom properties + typed TS. See docs/design/01-foundations.md. Colours marked HS-derived sit in the colour family HungerStation is documented to use; NO hex here is sampled from HungerStation (see 01-foundations.md 1.2).

brand.$description: Halal Goes ACTION orange (cleaned old-brand #FD5000 -> #F1521E, less fluorescent). This ramp is the primary action/CTA colour -- action.primary/control/trackOn resolve from it (build.ts / generate-tokens.mjs). Action is orange, NEVER green (decision docs/decisions/palette-and-invariant-10.md). Steps 500/600 are FILLS; brand as text on light must use step 700+.

500.$description: Action base. Primary button (CTA) fill. Label on it is text.onBrand (white); the client-mandated brand orange, white ~3.5:1 (see _pairs note).

600.$description: Pressed CTA; switch track on. 4.49:1 with white.

accent.$description: Forest 'pine'. Halal Goes brand/chrome. Amended invariant #10: the deep forest #1B3B31/#0F241C is a dark, low-chroma brand NEUTRAL (reads as chrome, like a charcoal/navy), NOT a green success/verified signal -- the verified emerald lives in color.halal.* and is deliberately brighter. Drives surface.chrome and action.secondary (app bars, restaurant/admin/rider chrome). Registered as an allowed neutral in lint L-4.

600.$description: Chrome base. surface.chrome; secondary button fill; restaurant/admin AppBar. 12.25:1 with white.

neutral.$description: Warm cream + ink. Halal Goes canvas/surfaces. neutral.0 white = card; neutral.50 warm cream = canvas (surface.base). Mid steps are warm/sage-tinted greys (very low chroma), neutral.900 = ink #232323.

200.$description: Border, warmed to the cream. border.decorative.

500.$description: Minimum colour that reaches 3:1 on cream -- the floor for interactive borders / placeholder.

1000.$description: Shadow colour only. Never a text or surface colour.

success.$description: Emerald, TINT-ONLY ROLE -- see RULE H-1: no filled green backgrounds outside color.halal.*. success.50 is the sage tint #E9F3E4 (de-neoned); text/icon are dark emerald. Never a solid fill, and deliberately not the halal seal emerald.

500.$description: Icon / 2px accent border only (3.39:1 on white). Not a fill.

warning.$description: Ember. Ours. ORANGE (~hue 28), never yellow -- brand yellow is spent on CTAs. 3.23:1 separation from brand.500.

500.$description: Icon only. As a fill with white it is 3.25:1 -- use 600.

600.$description: Warning fill with white label (5.22:1) and warning text on light (5.22:1).

danger.$description: True red. Ours. NEVER used by any halal state -- see RULE H-3. Kept a distinct red from the CTA orange (color.brand): darker and redder so a destructive action never reads as the primary action.

500.$description: Danger fill with white label (5.66:1). Distinct from brand orange #F1521E.

info.$description: Ours. Also the base of the focus ring.

300.$description: Dark-theme info text and dark focus ring (7.19:1).

500.$description: Info fill with white label (4.59:1); light focus ring (4.59:1 on white).

halal.$description: RESERVED NAMESPACE. Importable ONLY by HalalBadge, HalalCertificationPanel, admin HalalChecklist, and the registered map-pin exception. RULE H-1: halal.certified.seal is the only filled solid green surface in the system. RULE H-2: a halal state is a composite {fill, ring, glyph, label}, never a bare colour. RULE H-3: no halal state may use the danger ramp -- red would read as a religious ruling the platform does not make.

certified.$description: halal_display_state = CERTIFIED. Filled emerald seal, brass outer ring, solid shield glyph, label 'Halal certified' (exact string, C-12 R7). The seal emerald #0F7A43 is deliberately BRIGHTER/more saturated than the forest chrome (color.accent) so 'verified' pops and is never mistaken for chrome.

seal.$description: Light. Brighter emerald, distinct from forest chrome. 5.40:1 with white label; boundary against cream surface well above 3:1.

sealDark.$description: Dark theme. 4.65:1 with white label; ~3.8:1 against the near-black page.

ring.$description: Brass. 1.5px outer ring against seal. Decorative -- the informational boundary is seal-vs-surface. The single point where brand warmth touches the verification register.

expiring.$description: halal_display_state = EXPIRING_SOON. The CARD BADGE IS IDENTICAL TO CERTIFIED (C-12). These tokens style ONLY the renewal note row inside HalalCertificationPanel. Brass-ochre, deliberately NOT the semantic warning orange: the certificate is valid today; this is a transparency signal, not an alert.

expired.$description: halal_display_state = EXPIRED. Cool slate -- NOT the warm neutral ramp, so it reads as a certification state rather than as disabled chrome; and NOT red, per RULE H-3. Says 'the platform's knowledge has lapsed', not 'this food is not halal'. Customer surfaces never see this state (C-12 R1 hides the restaurant entirely); it appears on restaurant, admin and rider surfaces.

unverified.$description: halal_display_state = UNVERIFIED. CUSTOMER SURFACES RENDER NOTHING (C-12 R4: no badge, and a client error is logged if halal_display_state is absent -- there is no 'assume certified'). These tokens exist for restaurant/admin onboarding surfaces only. Transparent fill + dashed border + dashed shield glyph.

viz.$description: Admin chart categoricals. Avoids all reserved meanings.

pinRider.$description: REGISTERED EXCEPTION to the halal namespace lint (L-3/L-4). A rider pin is a Halal Goes rider, carries no shield, and makes no certification claim.

theme.$description: ROLES. Components consume these, never the numbered ramp steps (lint L-2). Each role carries a light and a dark value.

raised.$description: White card, raised above the cream canvas.

placeholder.$description: 3.33:1 -- placeholder only, never the sole label

disabled.$description: 2.20:1. WCAG 1.4.3 exempts disabled controls; disabled is ALSO signalled by 60% opacity + aria-disabled.

onBrand.$description: White label on the orange CTA (brand.500). ~3.5:1 -- the client-mandated brand orange; see _pairs note. The only permitted label colour on the brand fill.

decorative.$description: Warm border on cream. Decorative only -- never bounds an interactive control.

offset.$description: 2px offset in the page colour, drawn between the control and the ring.

onColor.$description: Ring flips to this on coloured containers where info.500 falls below 3:1 (brand 2.84, halal 2.33, danger 1.05, accent 2.24).

raised.$description: Dark elevation is a SURFACE STEP, not a shadow -- black shadow on near-black is invisible.

onBrand.$description: White label on the orange CTA (brand.500).

interactive.$description: 3.09:1 on surface.subtle. neutral.700 is only 1.82:1 and fails 1.4.11.

ui.$description: Adopted Sep 2026 (0cabf7c), replacing Inter; this token was left behind until Sep 18, so the apps loaded Plus Jakarta Sans while the token still declared Inter. RN registers 'PlusJakartaSans_400Regular'..'PlusJakartaSans_700Bold' via expo-font (four static weights, so no variable-font support needed); the chain applies on web only. RN has NO fallback chain -- a startup assertion must fail loudly if the family is unresolvable. Weaker than Inter at telling 1/l/I and 0/O apart, so identifiers that must not be misread use font.family.mono with font.numeric.tabular.

rtl.$description: Not shipped at launch (en-CA only). Pre-selected so RTL is a token swap, not a redesign.

mono.$description: Admin only: IDs, UUIDv7, certificate numbers, audit payloads.

tabular.$description: MANDATORY on Price, Countdown, StatusTimeline, DataTable, Rating. Web: font-variant-numeric. RN: style.fontVariant=['tabular-nums'] (iOS + Android API 26+); below that Countdown uses fixed-width layout.

typography.$description: lineHeight carries BOTH the unitless multiplier (web) and the resolved px (RN, which requires absolute lineHeight). If a fontSize changes, the resolved px must be regenerated.

display.lg.$description: Rider offer earnings; admin hero metric.

body.sm.$description: Floor for any text a customer must read to decide.

label.sm.$description: Badge and seal label. 'Halal certified' is sentence case at this token -- NOT all-caps (screen readers may spell out all-caps).

caption.$description: Timestamps; the standing line 'Certification verified by Halal Goes on {date}. Halal Goes does not itself certify food.'

density.$description: Set once at the theme root. Components read density.*; they never hard-code 16.

md.$description: Default. Also the halal seal -- a softly-squared plate reads as a seal; radius.full would read as a tag.

elevation.$description: Dual-form. Light themes use shadow; DARK THEMES IGNORE shadow and use surfaceStep instead.

sticky.$description: Floating cart bar; sticky checkout footer. Shadow points UP.

deliberate.$description: StatusTimeline step advance; halal seal first reveal.

spring.$description: MARKETING SURFACE ONLY. Slight overshoot for micro-interactions; transform and opacity only, never layout. Measured from wisprflow.ai. Pair with duration.base or duration.moderate.

linear.$description: COUNTDOWNS AND PROGRESS ONLY. Easing a deadline misrepresents remaining time.

reducedMotion.$description: prefers-reduced-motion / AccessibilityInfo.isReduceMotionEnabled collapses all durations to 0 and replaces slide/scale with cross-fade at duration.fast. Countdown NUMERALS keep updating -- they are information, not decoration.

icon.$description: Lucide (ISC). The halal shield is a BESPOKE inline SVG, never lucide/shield-check and never a font glyph -- a font glyph fails silently and would render a blank certification badge.

min.$description: WCAG 2.2 AAA / Apple HIG. Absolute floor everywhere.

field.$description: Rider app minimum -- gloved thumb, moving vehicle stationary, one-handed.

criticalField.$description: Rider Accept / Decline; restaurant Accept order. Irreversible-under-time-pressure actions.

offerSheet.$description: Rider offer sheet outranks everything. It is non-dismissible until server expires_at (D-14).

breakpoint.$description: Web surfaces only. The RN apps are phone-first and use density, not breakpoints.

lg.$description: Restaurant queue switches to 4 columns at/above this.

_pairs.$description: Machine-checked contrast pairs. contrast.check.mjs walks this list in CI; anything below `min` is a BUILD FAILURE, not a warning. `note` records documented exemptions.

$value.note: Muted ink #6E7C77 per the authoritative palette (docs/decisions/palette-and-invariant-10.md). AA-large / tertiary + timestamp text; never a sole critical label.

White label on the client-mandated brand orange #F1521E (CTA). ~3.5:1 -- AA-large; the brand orange is a fixed decision, not a token free to darken. Dark ink on it would be 4.5:1 but reads wrong on a vivid orange CTA.

AA. The seal is deliberately the BRIGHTER emerald #0F7A43 (distinct from forest chrome) per the amended invariant #10; a bottle-green dark enough for AAA-on-white would be confusable with the chrome. The seal's role is carried by the composite {fill, brass ring, shield, label}.
Seal boundary (1.4.11) against the cream canvas.
EXEMPT: decorative brass ring. The brighter seal reduces ring separation; the informational boundary is seal-vs-surface at 5.18:1.
AA on the dark-theme seal; also ~3.8:1 against the near-black page, compensated by the 1.5px brass ring.
Rider offer chrome (deep forest) -- field theme requires >=7:1 for ALL body text.
EXEMPT: WCAG 1.4.3 excludes disabled controls. Also signalled by 60% opacity + aria-disabled.
EXEMPT: decorative dividers only; never bounds an interactive control.
EXEMPT: decorative brass ring on the cream canvas. The seal's informational boundary is seal-vs-surface at 5.18:1.

_separation.$description: Pairs that must be DISTINGUISHABLE from one another (not fg/bg). Documents why RULE H-1 exists.

$value.verdict: CANNOT SEPARATE BY LUMINANCE. No two greens are both individually accessible and 3:1 apart. Separation is by FORM: the halal seal is the only filled solid green in the system (RULE H-1, lint L-4); semantic success is tint-only. The seal emerald is also kept brighter/more saturated than the forest chrome (color.accent) so 'verified' never reads as chrome.

Identical by design (both #E9F3E4 sage). Success tints never carry a shield glyph and never appear inside HalalCertificationPanel; the panel's tint is always accompanied by the seal and the certifying body's name.

CAUTION -- both are now orange (brand CTA ~hue 15, warning ember ~hue 23). Separated by ROLE not colour: brand is a filled CTA button, warning is icon + text under a warning glyph and never a large fill. Follow-up: consider nudging warning toward amber if the two ever collide in one surface.
